            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    # Find the L-shaped guide: its cells occupy a vertical and a horizontal
    # arm along two adjacent edges of its bounding box.
    def is_guide(cells):
        rs = [r for r, c in cells]
        cs = [c for r, c in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        height, width = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
        if height < 3 or width < 3:
            return False
        s = set(cells)
        patterns = (
            {(r, c0) for r in range(r0, r1+1)} |
            {(r0, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)},
            {(r, c1) for r in range(r0, r1+1)} |
            {(r0, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)},
            {(r, c0) for r in range(r0, r1+1)} |
            {(r1, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)},
            {(r, c1) for r in range(r0, r1+1)} |
            {(r1, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)}
        )
        return any(len(s & p) >= 0.8 * len(p) for p in patterns)

    guides = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if is_guide(cells)]
    if not guides:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    guide_color, guide_cells = max(guides, key=lambda x: len(x[1]))

        abs(r-y) + abs(c-z) for r, c in guide_cells for y, z in x[1]
    ))
